readiness_scope: See claim-maturity.json readiness_scope. Not production-live or customer-ready.

entries.name: Agent to SaaS mutual TLS
helps_prevent: Passive eavesdropping on enforced mTLS segments
entries.validation_level: Required in architecture; local-mock manifest proof; sandbox CI gates
entries.current_limitation: Not e2e-validated on every route or environment
entries.next_validation: Sandbox e2e agent sync with gate artifact
entries.public_safe_summary: mTLS is wired and mock-validated on documented agent routes — not production-live everywhere.

entries.name: Agent to SaaS HMAC
helps_prevent: Unsigned agent calls on HMAC-enforced routes
entries.validation_level: Middleware wired; automated crypto unit tests
entries.public_safe_summary: HMAC verifies agent context where enforced — not replay-proof delivery.

entries.name: Provider webhook signatures
helps_prevent: Forged Stripe-class payloads on configured wedge paths in mock scope
entries.validation_level: Wedge claim map PROVEN local_mock for Stripe signature path
entries.next_validation: Public sandbox e2e with negative signature case
entries.public_safe_summary: Provider signatures are evidenced for configured wedge sources — not all adapters.

entries.name: Constant-time signature comparison
entries.validation_level: Unit tests on shared compare helpers; not mapped to every ingress
entries.public_safe_summary: Constant-time compare is wired where used — not claimed on every path.

entries.name: SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity
entries.validation_level: Wired where deployed; fuller model planned
entries.next_validation: Published rotation drill in demo scope
entries.public_safe_summary: SPIFFE is used where implemented — SVID rotation is not production-live proof.

entries.name: ZenLock secret custody
entries.next_validation: Rotation drill without leaking material in public artifacts
entries.public_safe_summary: ZenLock encrypts configured secrets at rest — not all secrets or zero-knowledge.

entries.name: PostgreSQL row-level security
helps_prevent: Some cross-tenant SQL on RLS tables
entries.validation_level: Schema RLS policies; no public fuzz e2e
entries.public_safe_summary: RLS helps on covered tables — not enterprise isolation proof.

entries.name: Hash-chain evidence integrity
helps_detect: Tampering of included evidence artifacts vs published integrity roots
entries.validation_level: Automated integrity gates on evidence packs
entries.public_safe_summary: Hash-chain is tamper-evidence for artifacts — not auth, identity, encryption, or replay control.

entries.name: Idempotency and duplicate detection
helps_detect: Duplicate delivery within idempotency window in mock scenarios
entries.validation_level: Manifest victory_locked duplicate-idempotency; mock execution category
entries.current_limitation: At-least-once with dedup — not replay prevention
entries.public_safe_summary: Idempotency reduces duplicate processing in tested scenarios — not replay-proof.

entries.name: Outbound-only edge connectivity
helps_prevent: Inbound listener requirement for wedge private-network pattern
entries.public_safe_summary: Outbound-only edge is a structural wedge property — not full delivery security.

entries.name: Canary TLS certificate rotation
helps_prevent: Some big-bang cert cutovers on canary-enabled workloads
entries.next_validation: E2e canary gate for egress parity
entries.public_safe_summary: Canary rotation is partial by workload — not production-live everywhere.

entries.name: SSRF controls for SaaS dispatch
entries.validation_level: Webhook-security gates only — not SSRF contract
entries.public_safe_summary: SSRF hardening is backlog — gates do not justify SSRF-safe wording.

entries.name: Large payload pointer model
entries.public_safe_summary: Large payload pointer model is not shipped.
